Knowledge of supply chain optimization, demand planning, capacity planning, and scenario modeling methodologies. Experience using AI, sophisticated analytics, automation technologies, and digital transformation solutions to improve business processes. Strong executive-level communication and presentation skills with talent for converting detailed analysis into strategic business recommendations. Title: Senior Healthcare Analytics Business Analyst
